key_catalyst: Alphabet's Q2 capex guidance raised to $195-205B, triggering a ~4% drop and crystallizing the AI capex ROI concern that now threatens all mega-cap tech valuations
reasoning: Two top QQQ holdings (Alphabet -4%, Tesla -4%) confirmed the market's worst fear — AI capex is eroding returns — and this narrative shift is still developing with more mega-cap capex reveals ahead. Simultaneously, the oil/geopolitical theme escalated to a new theater (Houthi attacks on Saudi tankers in the Red Sea, Trump warning of strikes on Iranian infrastructure), pushing Brent to $96.50 and the 10-year yield to its highest since January with a 30% Fed hike probability now priced. The index's modest -0.72% decline understates the combined severity, suggesting the market has not fully caught up to the compounding macro and earnings risks.
